Meet Your Planner

Jessica Lueken

I'm a wife, mother, and the self-proclaimed funniest sibling in my family (just ask me, I'll tell you). When I'm not planning celebrations, chasing my children, or waving bye to my teens, you'll find me advocating for The Lord of the Rings over Game of Thrones, Pride & Prejudice over Bridgerton, and family game nights over anything else. I'm an avid reader without enough time to read, a history lover, and a movie aficionado who appreciates stories that stand the test of time - much like the celebrations I create.

My passion for the beautiful controlled chaos of events comes directly from watching my mom and her best friend create incredible birthday events on shoestring budgets when we were children. They taught me that the most extraordinary experiences aren’t celebrations designed to impress, they're designed to honor. For over 12 years in the Hospitality & Events industry, I've carried that lesson into every celebration I touch - because the best parties aren't about impressing guests, they're about creating moments where genuine love, gratitude, and joy come together.

My Approach

I believe your celebration should feel like the best dinner party your family has ever attended - elevated, thoughtful, and genuinely focused on bringing people together to celebrate love and connection.

My approach is built on three foundations:

Transparency

You'll always know where your investment is going and why. Every recommendation is rooted in your values, your vision, and the experience you want your guests to have.

Discretion

Your celebration, your family dynamics, and your planning journey remain private. I understand that planning a meaningful wedding involves navigating family expectations, traditions, and sometimes complicated relationships. You can trust me to handle every detail with sensitivity and confidentiality.

Genuine Partnership

I'm not here to execute someone else's vision of what your wedding should be. I'm here to understand what matters most to you as a couple, help you honor your family's foundation, and create a celebration that launches you into your next chapter.

The Aisle to Islands Difference

Your job is to get married and be present for the people you love. Mine is to run everything that makes that possible — designing your celebration, directing your creative team, and managing every logistical layer from first vendor call to final farewell.

  • I coordinate your complete destination experience - ceremony design, guest room blocks, vendor management, and welcome events - without handing anything off.
  • The result? One trusted partner who understands your complete vision and ensures every element, from your first guest's arrival to your last farewell, works together seamlessly

Working With Me

When you work with me, you can expect:

  • To be heard once and remembered throughout — your priorities don't need repeating
  • Clarity at every stage, without being buried in details that aren't yours to manage
  • A creative vision that's entirely yours, executed by people who know how to bring it to life
  • Decisions made on your behalf - confidently, and without pulling you in unnecessarily
  • A celebration that feels like you, honors your family, and runs so well the effort is invisible
  • To be completely present for the people who traveled to celebrate with you

Let's Talk

If this approach resonates with you, I'd love to hear about your celebration.
